name: Leash
description: An AI agent wallet with on-chain spend limits. Leash holds funds in a SpendPolicyAccount contract that enforces per-transaction caps, UTC-daily caps and a payee allowlist in Solidity, so an agent's spending authority is bounded by the chain rather than by a prompt. The agent's operator key holds zero CELO and pays gas in a stablecoin through Celo's fee-currency abstraction. Built for the Celo Agents at Work hackathon.
